text: In 1978 Rockbridge, California, bullied high school senior Arnie Cunningham [buys a dilapidated 1958 Plymouth Fury|trigger|bringing something home] named Christine, despite the doubts of his only friend Dennis. As he restores her in a local garage, Arnie turns arrogant and rebellious, his new girlfriend Leigh nearly chokes when [the car locks its doors on her|wants|a lover to possess], and the radio plays 1950s rock and roll by itself. When the bullies who wrecked her start dying, [Christine drives off in flames|images|fire, smoke and burning] and is whole again by morning.
